title: kc-plan-approval v1
description: The Captain's dispatch authorization for one receipt. Separate from the receipt so the receipt is content and the approval is authority. ship-flow refuses a receipt without a matching approval whose receipt_sha256 equals the receipt's.

decision.description: go authorizes dispatch; discover and stop carry no dispatch authority and ship-flow refuses them

findings_outside_brief.description: which review-finding classes block the candidate; security, data-loss, and compatibility block; everything else is listed in UAT

minimal_necessity_fail.description: when a candidate's falsifier cannot fail: record accepted_no_pr and carry disposition to UAT; do not open PR

moved_base.description: when base advances under an accepted candidate: rebase and re-accept; do not ask

worker_blocker.description: when worker stops on BLOCKER: skip that Issue, continue rest, list in UAT

empty_reviewer.description: when cross-model reviewer returns nothing: treat as reviewer-absent, FO reads diff, record absence

pr_creation.description: whether FO opens Draft PRs without per-PR approval: one approval authorizes whole batch's Draft PRs
